steps.text: 'You will come back? Really? After you become a knight?'
'It's a promise then. We'll wait for you to come home, showered in glory, and then we'll spread the word that our town is the home of the Justyna, the knight!'

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: My... home.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Careful.

steps.name: Carefree Boy
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Carefree Boy
steps.text: I've never seen you in the village. Are you from outside?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I was born here. Then I went to Kawalerielki.

steps.name: Carefree Boy
steps.text: Kawalerielki! Are you a knight?

steps.name: Carefree Boy
steps.text: You must be! Your armor looks much better than the wooden stuff Hubert makes.

steps.name: Carefree Boy
steps.text: Can I see your crossbow?

steps.name: Kind Villager
steps.text: Millen! Stop bothering people!

steps.name: Kind Villager
steps.text: I'm sorry, the boy's been reading too many knight novels lately. The questions flow nonstop when he meets someone from out of town.

steps.name: Kind Villager
steps.text: Wait, is it just me... or do you look familiar...?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Aunt Danka.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: Justyna...? You're really back... oh, I suppose it's Fartooth Knight now.

spans.text: Justyna...? You're really back... oh, I suppose it's

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: We saw the news about your title. Everyone's happy for you.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: You remember old Cole? He saves clippings of every headline about you on his wall.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: He opens a bottle whenever you win a competition—probably just an excuse for him to drink more.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: But...

a.text: The woman carefully scans Justyna, looking for something—perhaps expecting to see something.
Justyna is familiar with this look.
She has seen it many times in Kawalerielki, from opponents, spectators, reporters... countless eyes looking, searching, just to see—

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: You got sick... we heard about it on the news. Everyone in the village is worried.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's under control.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: Very good, very good.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: What's that in your hand, Millen?

steps.name: Millen
steps.text: The knight's quiver.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: Don't touch that!

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: Err, I mean... give it back to Fartooth Knight. It's very expensive.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: It's dangerous, even if it won't hurt you.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'm sorry, I should be more considerate.

steps.name: Aunt Danka
steps.text: Do you want to sit a spell, Fartooth Knight? We've all missed you. I'll just need to give them a heads-up... to prepare properly.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What are you standing there for, Fartooth?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: We have to count the Infected after the evacuation.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Group Two, all accounted for.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (When did she count them? She was definitely daydreaming.)

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Has anyone seen Zola? Where did she go?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Is something wrong, Mr. Farone?

steps.name: Farone
steps.text: I think Zola went out to take a look at the new camp, but she's not back yet.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Did anyone see her when we moved over from Residential Sector 9?

steps.name: Farone
steps.text: I wasn't paying attention... it was still dark, and I was leading the way for a villager with a bad leg...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Don't worry, we'll find her, but we need to narrow down the area. There are a lot of buildings between the two sectors.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Sona...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I may know where the girl went.
The day before...

steps.name: Cheerful Infected
steps.text: Hello again, friends.

steps.name: Infected Knight
steps.text: How many times has it been in the last six months?

steps.name: Cheerful Infected
steps.text: This is the fourth.

steps.name: Cheerful Infected
steps.text: It's been a long stay in this abandoned industrial area, all things considered. Three full months since the last evacuation.

steps.name: Cheerful Infected
steps.text: I still remember that time the Armorless Union came knocking just a few days after we settled down. Since then, I've kept my stuff down to what I can fit in a couple of bags, ready to leave at a moment's notice.

steps.name: Infected Knight
steps.text: Sorry, folks. Sona's working to find a place you can stay for the long haul.

steps.name: Cheerful Infected
steps.text: It's not your fault. It's all thanks to Pinus Sylvestris that we're still able to stay in Kawalerielki at all. Besides, where can a bunch of Infected go?

steps.name: Cheerful Infected
steps.text: We got used to it when we wandered the edge of the nomadic plate. But Zola didn't like it, and even had a fight with Mr. Farone over it in the morning.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The General Chamber of Commerce crackdown is intensifying. Not just the commercial plates; the residential areas aren't safe anymore.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Armorless Union patrols have been spotted on the streets nearby. Not many, but it's a warning sign.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I say we pound 'em flat and show those empty suits this is Pinus Sylvestris turf.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: And give them an excuse to blow up our factory while we're short-handed?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What do you think, Justyna?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...It's just an abandoned factory.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's right! We'll find another place nearby—

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...It's not home.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Their home was destroyed in a Catastrophe. They should move to a safer place, so that more may live.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Fartooth!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We don't have what it takes to butt heads with the GCC directly, not yet. Maybe someday we'll have our own plate, and every Infected in Kawalerielki will have a home to go back.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We are setting out first thing tomorrow morning. Ashley and I know the routes best, so we'll lead the pack. Iwona, you clear any obstacles. Justyna, you're on recon duty.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: As for tonight—

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'll keep watch.

a.text: The abandoned factory is located in Residential Sector 9, underneath Commercial Sectors 5 and 11, on the edge of the nomadic plate, where energy is always at a premium.

Justyna has crossed paths with these refugees quite a few times since she joined Pinus Sylvestris. They laugh at their rotten luck; they have been on the move more than any other Infected group receiving protection.
Justyna does not know how long they have been away from home. Sona told her that one of the older members carried a bag of crop seeds for the last evacuation; this time, he has thrown it away.
But would their village have been their home, even if it was not destroyed by Catastrophe?
'Do you want to sit a spell, Fartooth Knight?'
Justyna hums a tune from her hometown, and the noisy, sorrowful winds of Kawalerielki hum with her.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Is that...?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Zola?

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Those people in black weren't here in this alley a few days ago...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: No, I'll be late if I take any more detours. I'll have to...
What are you doing here?

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Mmph—

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Don't leave the camp at night. It's dangerous.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Justyna...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'll take you back.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: No, no! Rita's waiting for me!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Rita?

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Don't tell Mr. Farone, please. He'll be mad if he finds out I'm friends with a kid from the residential district.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: But Rita's a good girl, really. She doesn't care about my sickness, she says I'm good at drawing...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Why do we have to move all the time, Justyna?

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: I am the same as everybody else when I wrap myself up. Nobody found out I was sick when Rita took me into a shop.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: I don't want to move again...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: After the village got destroyed, we drifted around the wilderness, slowly running out of food.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: We were only able to get into Kawalerielki because Mr. Farone found Sona.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: But we're still drifting. We just do it underground now.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: I can barely remember the berries that grew on the trees of the village. I used to love them so much...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: We wouldn't be like this if the village was still around.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Is there anywhere the Infected can go at all...?

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Was your home destroyed by Catastrophe too?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No, that village has not faced a single Catastrophe in its entire history.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Sounds nice... where is it? Is it pretty?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It sits in the north, where the forest meets the plains.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It is... a beautiful place.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: What's your hometown like, Justyna? Tell me all about it!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Maybe next time.

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: A third patrol?

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Come in, patrol... come in... do you require backup...?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: We need to move.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: But I haven't said goodbye to Rita yet...

steps.name: Farone
steps.text: I told her not to play with uninfected children!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: There are no kids Zola's age in the camp. She's lonely.

steps.name: Infected Knight
steps.text: The Armorless Union doesn't care that she's a child.

steps.name: Infected Knight
steps.text: She's Infected. To them, young doesn't mean innocent; it just means easier cleanup.

spans.text: She's Infected. To them, young doesn't mean innocent; it just means easier

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Justyna. How sure are you about Zola?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...I can't be sure.

steps.name: Infected Knight
steps.text: We ruffled feathers when we got out of Sector 9. The Armorless Union is probably watching the warehouse right now. Scouts, troopers... they'll be out in force.

steps.name: Infected Knight
steps.text: It's not just this district that we have to protect. There's another group of refugees who just arrived at the outskirts of Kawalerielki today, waiting for our escort.

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin A
steps.text: I thought I heard something in that storage room. Should we check it out?

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin B
steps.text: In an abandoned warehouse like this, there're bound to be critters crawling around. I'm not going in there.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The storage room... that's where Zola was drawing her pictures!

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Green... red stripes...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Yes, yes... and yellow, just like her eyes.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: There's a pattern on her quiver, and shiny bolts inside.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Justyna's an amazing shot... one bolt, and all the bad guys in black scatter...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: No need to be scared... no need to be scared...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The scope's in the wrong place.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I couldn't aim properly if it were so far forward.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Justyna!

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: I... I'm so sorry... I just wanted to get the parting gift I made for Rita...

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: I wanted to keep it... even if I couldn't give it to her...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: You'll meet again.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Let's get out of here. Can you walk?

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: I twisted my ankle when I came in... I'm sorry... I'm so scared...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's okay. No need to apologize.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Close your eyes, Zola.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Yesterday, you asked me what my hometown was like.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Close your eyes, and I'll tell you all about it.

a.text: The smell of haystacks.
The untrimmed stalks sting a little. Lie upon them, and all you see is the clear blue sky.
The sound of the flowing waves of wheat.
A bug buzzing in the air—

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Wh-What's that sound?!

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: A-Are you okay, Justyna?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'm fine. Keep your eyes shut.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The bug lands on a wheat stalk. The harvest sickle swings, and it dives into the soil.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: And the wind.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The melody on the wind is the little tune that Uncle Cole liked to play.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: That's my... home.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: (The reinforcements came quickly. It's going to be hard to get through the front door carrying Zola...)

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: What was that sound?

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: We're under attack! This is where the Infected knights have been harboring the refugees. Be on your guard!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: (Come on, Justyna... you've faced down multiple enemies in the tourneys... you can think of something...)

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Wild Mane?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So many assassins to guard one abandoned warehouse. Since when is the GCC in the business of bleeding money?

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: You think you can take us all by yourself?

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: Hmph, one more helper won't make a difference—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You're rushing too far ahead, Wild Mane!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's what being a lancer is all about—charging into the fray and messing up enemy formations! Standard tactics.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Then what's the point of making a plan?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Got to adapt to change.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley means you're too far from the formation for her to protect you with her shield.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: That's not what I said!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: We're here to get Justyna, aren't we? Where is she?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: There.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You were right, Justyna. You found Zola.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Thanks... all of you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The rest of the knights are off to help our new friends. We were always going to hold back here.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I just didn't expect you to charge even faster than me.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: We haven't talked much, but I think I like you!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: More guys coming in, eleven o'clock and two o'clock.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: They're too scattered. I don't have enough ammo left.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Leave it to me.

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: They have a sniper! Form up, don't get picked off!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Good job.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Front door's open. All the Armorless Union assassins in the factory are down.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Communications equipment's dealt with. There won't be any more reinforcements for a while.
Something isn't right.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Zola? You can open your eyes now. A pity you missed the fight, but you are too young for this.
The wind isn't right.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Justyna? What's the matter?

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Phew, that was close.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Didn't see that sniper up there.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: How'd you spot him, Justyna?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I couldn't hear the sound of the wind.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Well... there's a window there. Wind affects the trajectory of a projectile.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I'm guessing you didn't get it either.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You'll get used to the way Justyna talks soon enough.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Zola.

steps.name: Zola
steps.text: Justyna...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's safe now.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Let's go home.

a.text: Justyna climbs the observation deck. Wind whirls through the streets, through gaps in the sewer pipes, swaying the less-than-sturdy scaffolding.
Back at the camp, Farone scolds Zola for running out on her own. Seeing her teacher's mouth twitch with fear and worry, Zola does not argue and simply grips the hands of her loved ones.

All of them will go into dreamland, not thinking about when the next evacuation might be, not asking whether this nomadic life might ever come to an end. Home is where they have made their beds from cardboard boxes and clothes.
Once again, she takes out her flute.
Brr—

steps.text: 'Beep beep'—

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Inquisitive beeping)

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Wild Mane's... pet?

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Joyous beeping)

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Cheerful beeping)

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Hey, stop! You'll wake everyone up!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Where's the switch?

a.text: The Liberi fumbles with the unfamiliar beeping machine, dropping her flute to the ground.
Apparently sensing her predicament, Justice Knight considerately spins around and turns on its searchlight.
No, no... Justyna tries to block the light with her body, and realizes that Justice Knight is taller than she.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The switch is behind the plate.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I wouldn't recommend shutting her off, though. Justice Knight gets lonely when she can't get a signal around her.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You like to be with people, don't you?

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Joyous beeping)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, Justyna... what's that sound? I've never heard it before...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's my flute.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You play the flute?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Oh... I see.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You had Justice put out a call because you wanted an audience, didn't you?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Well, you've found one. I don't know much about music, but I'm a great listener.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Go ahead and play, Fartooth Knight.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You just wanted to get in on the action.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Greynuty?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Did Justice wake you up too?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No, YOU woke me up.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You should thank me, then. Justyna is putting on a show.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Don't pressure her... is that a flute?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I used to live near an old woman with a bad leg. I could hear her playing in her house, one of these hand-made flutes.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Now I'm starting to miss the traditional melodies from back in the day.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What's that? An attic party, and I wasn't invited?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And there I was, thinking I was giving you a bit more sleep after that rescue operation.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You got woken up too?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I was thinking about Zola.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona's right. We can't hide underground forever.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: People have gotten so used to the nomadic life that they're beginning to forget even the Infected deserve to have a home.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Come down and hear out my new idea, since you're up anyway.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What about the show?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Maybe next time, Iwona.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'll play you a song from home.
